name: YFCC100M-Downloader
what_it_holds: Python multiprocessing downloader for the metadata of the Yahoo Flickr Creative Commons 100M dataset: ~99.2M photos + 0.8M videos with geotags, timestamps, and CC licence info, fetched in two steps (index then file download). Repo does not host the data itself. 42 stars, no stated licence for the tool.
why_useful: Working, non-scraper acquisition path for YFCC100M's geotagged Flickr photo/video metadata (100M items, worldwide, with capture timestamps) -- could be filtered to top tourism destinations for a photo-volume travel-flow proxy, one of the explicit theme targets (YFCC100M tourism subsets).
size_hint: n/a (downloader); parent dataset is 100M Flickr photos/videos with metadata
themes: Twitter/X, Instagram, Flickr, TikTok tourism datasets: geotagged tourism flows, YFCC100M tourism subsets, Foursquare/Gowalla/Brightkite check-ins

name: FinBERT (Yang, UcHRoy, Huang) — finance-domain BERT incl. earnings-call pretraining
what_it_holds: Pretrained BERT for financial text, trained on 4.9B tokens: 10-K/10-Q corporate reports (2.5B tokens), EARNINGS CALL TRANSCRIPTS (1.3B tokens), and analyst reports (1.1B tokens); the released finbert-tone variant is fine-tuned on 10,000 manually labeled (pos/neg/neutral) analyst-report sentences. Apache-2.0, 661 stars, 144 forks. Model weights hosted on Hugging Face (yiyanghkust/finbert-tone), including ESG and forward-looking-statement variants.
why_useful: A ready-made, earnings-call-trained tone/sentiment scorer (not a raw ABNB dataset, but a validated tool) that could score ABNB's own and peer transcripts for management-tone features feeding the guide-composition model, without needing to build a tone classifier from scratch.
size_hint: 4.9B token pretraining corpus (not redistributed raw); 10k labeled sentences for fine-tuning
last_activity: not stated precisely; multiple HF model variants released
duplicate_of_holding: team already tested 'management tone' and found it did not beat naive on our construction; this is a different, earnings-call-pretrained tone tool worth trying before concluding tone is dead
themes: Earnings-call transcript datasets and NLP tooling (ECT datasets, Motley Fool scrapers, Seeking Alpha parsers), management-tone corpora
why_all: A ready-made, earnings-call-trained tone/sentiment scorer (not a raw ABNB dataset, but a validated tool) that could score ABNB's own and peer transcripts for management-tone features feeding the guide-composition model, without needing to build a tone classifier from scratch.

name: Earnings-Implied-Move-Mispricing
what_it_holds: Research framework studying earnings-implied-move mispricing via option straddle prices vs. realized post-earnings moves. Notebooks build base/loose/strict event datasets of 9,804 / 9,022 / 7,412 earnings events (2018-2024) using WRDS, OptionMetrics, and CRSP; regresses straddle 'edge' (realized minus implied move) on pre-earnings IV, bid-ask spreads, open interest, volume, price; expanding-window OOS validation 2018-2020 train / 2021-2024 test; includes a research paper PDF.
why_useful: Directly on-theme methodology for constructing an ABNB earnings-implied-move / vol-crush estimator ahead of the 5 Nov print (straddle price vs realized move), which is exactly the reverse-DCF/market-implied-move work already underway (see reverse-dcf-run memory note) — worth a closer read for the modeling approach even if the underlying tickers are not ABNB.
duplicate_of_holding: overlaps in spirit with our own market-implied reverse-DCF work (12-13 Sep 2026, docs/reverse_dcf/SYNTHESIS.md) which already derived a 12M implied-move sd of 9.5% for the 5 Nov print; this repo's method could be a cross-check, not a new number
themes: Options and event-move tooling: historical option chains (CBOE samples, ORATS-like), earnings implied-move calculators, IV term-structure datasets, earnings-drift datasets

name: OIPD (options-implied-probability)
what_it_holds: Python library (354 stars, Apache-2.0) that fits an arbitrage-free implied-volatility surface from an options chain and converts it into a market-implied probability distribution for the underlying's future price; built-in free yfinance data connector; example notebooks pull GME options live.
why_useful: Directly usable as a method to build an ABNB earnings-implied-move / implied-distribution estimate from current Yahoo option chains (which the team already holds) ahead of the 5 Nov print — a ready-made implied-move calculator rather than data itself.
duplicate_of_holding: uses the same Yahoo current-options-chain source already held; adds an implied-move METHOD on top, not new raw data

name: Financial-Market-Event-Study-Python
what_it_holds: Reusable Python event-study framework: OLS market-model estimation, abnormal returns (AR) and cumulative abnormal returns (CAR), statistical significance testing, and visualization, built on historical price data (user-supplied, not bundled).
why_useful: Generic, reusable event-study package (not a one-off single-ticker notebook) that we could point at ABNB earnings dates plus the peer set (BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT) to measure abnormal-return reactions and drift; directly matches gap #17 (event-study packages, earnings-implied-move estimators).
